request.style: English, female solo voice, gentle and reflective, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, light percussion, warm and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
So I urge you by the mercies of God
Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice
Holy and pleasing to Him in spirit
This is your true spiritual worship

[Chorus]
Do not be conformed to this age
Be transformed by the renewing of your mind
So that you can discern His will
What is good and pleasing and perfect

[Verse]
Do not think of yourself more highly
Than you ought with sober judgment
According to the measure of faith
God has assigned to each of us

[Chorus]
Do not be conformed to this age
Be transformed by the renewing of your mind
So that you can discern His will
What is good and pleasing and perfect

[Bridge]
Just as in one body we have many parts
Not all the parts have the same function
We are one body in Christ
Each of us belongs to all the others

[Outro]
Be transformed by the renewing of your mind
Discern what is good and pleasing and perfect
